music_moods.epic: big cinematic reveals: film and TV news, trailers, major launches
music_moods.tense: mysteries, horror, creepy games, suspense, anything with a dark twist
music_moods.space: space, astronomy, nature wonders, calm science
music_moods.action: action games, fighting games, racing, high-energy sport
music_moods.retro: retro games, the 80s and 90s, nostalgia, synth-heavy worlds like Vice City
music_moods.playful: cosy and family games, animals, quirky facts, light-hearted stories
music_moods.pop: pop stars, K-pop, celebrities, bright entertainment news
music_moods.hiphop: rap and hip hop artists, streetwear, sport culture and swagger
music_moods.country: country and folk artists, Americana, rural stories
music_moods.rock: rock bands, festivals, motorsport, loud and gritty topics
music_moods.latin: Latin and Spanish-language artists, world football, summer energy
music_moods.orchestral: history, royalty, classical music, documentary tone

approval_note: all: every Short waits for Charlie's OK; flagged: only Shorts with a reason to look wait (the end goal); none: everything uploads straight away.
note: Two writer runs a day: 06:50 writes up to per_session (14); 12:50 writes the rest of daily_limit (6) from fresher trends; a 17:35 catch-up writes whatever a blocked run missed. The channel has YouTube's Advanced features (video verification approved 18 October), so the 10-a-day upload cap is gone; if YouTube still refuses an upload for the limit, the Short waits and the next run retries. The YouTube Data API allows about 100 uploads a day.
tiktok_note: inbox: the day's 5 TikTok picks land in the TikTok phone app as drafts once scheduled, and Charlie posts them with the captions from his TikTok queue page; manual: he uploads them himself; direct: posts by itself (needs TikTok's review).
instagram_note: picks: only the day's picks (the Shorts marked tiktok: true) go to Instagram, at most instagram_per_day in 24 hours; all: every Short.
reserve_note: Evergreen Shorts in boards/reserve, approved in advance, upload only on a day nothing new was written by reserve_after (UK), at most reserve_per_day of them.
